After correction for multiple testing, associations between rSNPs 1 and 4, and haplotype 2 and meat quality were significant. We have shown that a novel variant of the ankyrin 1 gene is present in muscle. This variant is longer than previously reported variants (NCBI) and increases the overall gene length by 341 bp in the 5’ direction.
